title: Waqrapukara Fortress
short_description: An essential tour to discover one of Cusco's most impressive natural and archaeological wonders.
long_description:
ONLY SCHEDULE: 04:00 AM – 18:00 PM APPROX
Dare to explore Waqrapukara, the horn-shaped fortress that rises over the Apurímac canyon. An adventure full of energy, history, and breathtaking landscapes.
price_note: Includes transportation, entrance tickets and professional guide.

days.title: Día 1 – Cusco / City Tour
days.text: We leave Cusco early heading south, enjoying Andean landscapes, local communities, and a mysterious natural environment. After a scenic hike surrounded by mountains and rock formations, we arrive at the impressive Inca sanctuary known as "the horned fortress," a symbol of spiritual and military power. From the top, at 4100 MASL, the views of the Apurímac canyon are truly unforgettable.
